observation_contract.zero_rule: A numeric value, including 0, exists only for state=measured; every non-measurement state forbids value.

metrics.description: Elapsed navigation start to first response byte.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: the lifecycle-aware field-vital callback reports a value
valid_when: both landmarks exist and are finite
navigation_start is not after response_start

names.name: ttfbMs
names.compatibility_condition: responseStart - startTime with an available navigation entry

synthetic_mapping.reason: The field and synthetic landmarks match; their samples and reports remain separate.

metrics.description: Elapsed navigation start to first contentful paint.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: the lifecycle-aware field-vital callback reports a value
valid_when: both landmarks exist and are finite
navigation_start is not after first_contentful_paint

synthetic_mapping.reason: Both contracts use the first-contentful-paint landmark.

metrics.description: Elapsed navigation start to the lifecycle-final largest contentful paint.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: the lifecycle-aware field-vital callback finalizes the value
valid_when: both landmarks exist and are finite
navigation_start is not after largest_contentful_paint

names.name: lcpMs
names.compatibility_condition: a buffered LCP entry exists; the synthetic zero default is absence, not a measurement

synthetic_mapping.reason: The landmark matches only for produced values because the current harness substitutes zero when LCP is absent.

metrics.description: Lifecycle-final cumulative layout shift score excluding shifts after recent input.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: the lifecycle-aware field-vital callback finalizes the value
valid_when: layout-shift observation is supported
only shifts without recent input contribute

names.name: cls
names.compatibility_condition: the value accumulates layout shifts without recent input

synthetic_mapping.reason: Both contracts accumulate the same layout-shift entries.

metrics.description: Lifecycle-final interaction to next paint value for the page.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: the lifecycle-aware field-vital callback finalizes the value
valid_when: Event Timing is supported
at least one qualifying interaction occurred

synthetic_mapping.reason: The synthetic maximum event duration is diagnostic evidence, not INP.

metrics.description: Elapsed navigation start until the surface presents meaningful content or an honest terminal empty, unavailable, or error state.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: the surface owner reports its first semantic terminal state
valid_when: both landmarks exist and are finite
navigation_start is not after semantic_content_ready
the terminal state is meaningful content or honest empty, unavailable, or error

synthetic_mapping.reason: The home fixture waits for compatible readiness markers but does not emit a named duration; no global DOM-ready alias exists.

metrics.description: Elapsed component activation until that component presents useful content or an honest terminal empty, unavailable, or error state.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: the component owner reports its first semantic terminal state
valid_when: both landmarks exist and are finite
component_activation is not after semantic_component_ready
the terminal state is useful content or honest empty, unavailable, or error

names.name: settledMs
names.compatibility_condition: the named Land outcome component reaches its present first-paint marker

synthetic_mapping.reason: The Land fixture matches only its named present-state component contract; its absent marker is not currently produced.

metrics.description: Elapsed interaction start until the first visible acknowledgement of that action.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: the interaction owner reports its first visible feedback landmark
valid_when: both landmarks exist and are finite
interaction_start is not after visible_feedback

synthetic_mapping.reason: Synchronous click-handler duration is not a visible feedback landmark.

metrics.description: Elapsed interaction start until the resulting component reaches its semantic settled state.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: the interaction owner reports the resulting semantic terminal state
valid_when: both landmarks exist and are finite
interaction_start is not after interaction_settled
the terminal state is useful content or honest empty, unavailable, or error

names.name: settledMs
names.compatibility_condition: input begins the action and canonical query plus row-or-empty result ends it

synthetic_mapping.reason: Only the Contracts keyword fixture has the same action-to-settled landmarks.

metrics.description: Elapsed first visible interaction feedback until the resulting component reaches its semantic settled state.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: both ordered interaction landmarks are available in the browser
valid_when: both landmarks exist and are finite
visible_feedback is not after interaction_settled

synthetic_mapping.reason: The synthetic harness has no distinct visible-feedback timestamp paired with settlement.

metrics.description: Elapsed first response byte to first contentful paint.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: all ordered load-decomposition landmarks are available in the browser
valid_when: all load landmarks exist and are finite
navigation_start through semantic_content_ready are ordered

synthetic_mapping.reason: The harness reports navigation metrics separately and has no named phase metric.

metrics.description: Elapsed first contentful paint to largest contentful paint.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: all ordered load-decomposition landmarks are available in the browser
valid_when: all load landmarks exist and are finite
navigation_start through semantic_content_ready are ordered

synthetic_mapping.reason: The harness reports navigation metrics separately and has no named phase metric.

metrics.description: Elapsed largest contentful paint to semantic content readiness.

lifecycle.finalize_condition: all ordered load-decomposition landmarks are available in the browser
valid_when: all load landmarks exist and are finite
navigation_start through semantic_content_ready are ordered

synthetic_mapping.reason: The harness waits for readiness but emits no named readiness duration or phase metric.
